title: Endpoint Telemetry: script_execution v1
description: Advisory telemetry event emitted when a script interpreter executes. Covers PowerShell, Python, bash, cmd, wscript, and similar interpreters. All fields are observational only — no enforcement.

process_name.description: Name of the script interpreter process (e.g. 'powershell.exe', 'python3').

parent_process_name.description: Name of the parent process that launched the interpreter.

command_line.description: Full command line as observed by the OS.

script_source.description: How the script content was provided to the interpreter.

is_encoded.description: True if a base64-encoded or compressed payload was detected in the command line.

decoded_preview.description: First 256 characters of decoded script content. Advisory — never used for automated blocking.

script_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the decoded script content when available.

telemetry_source.description: Collection mechanism that produced this event.

is_advisory.description: Always true — this event is observational only. No enforcement is performed.

autonomous_action.description: Always false — no autonomous action is taken on this telemetry.
